flow.rule: 生成前先与用户交互拿齐三项:①汇报背景②材料假设hypothesis③标出高质量重点素材;三项都用进报告;hypothesis只验证/证伪、不迎合

flow.name: Source Curation
flow.rule: 素材切片配 S-xxx ID

flow.name: Claim Analysis
flow.rule: 抽 claim 挂 source_ids, 强制标冲突

flow.name: Insight Extraction
flow.rule: 案例提炼成规律, 只在 claims 内推理

flow.name: Narrative Composition
flow.rule: 论断携带 [S-xxx]/[C-xxx]

flow.name: Verification
flow.rule: 独立对抗, 查编造/混用/剔噪

subagents.name: SourceCurator
subagents.responsibility: 素材切片、配 ID、去重

subagents.name: Analyst
subagents.responsibility: 抽 claim 挂 source、标冲突、判信源充分性

subagents.name: Insight
subagents.responsibility: 提炼规律/归因/趋势/建议, 只在 claims 内

subagents.name: Writer
subagents.responsibility: 金字塔组织、携带引用、结构化呈现

subagents.name: Verifier
subagents.responsibility: 对抗查错(编造/混用/噪音/越界)
